institutions.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
institutions.desc_en: Holds the Gilbert and Lila Silverman Fluxus Collection and many instruction-based works in the gallery, from Fluxkit and Water Yam to Simone Forti's Dance Constructions, and staged Haacke's MoMA Poll and Abramović's The Artist Is Present.
institutions.desc_zh: 收藏 Gilbert and Lila Silverman 激浪派收藏以及本站许多指令型作品（从 Fluxkit、Water Yam 到 Simone Forti 的 Dance Constructions），并上演过 Haacke 的 MoMA Poll 与 Abramović 的 The Artist Is Present。

institutions.name: Getty Research Institute
institutions.desc_en: Research centre whose archives hold scores by Cage, Brecht, Knowles, Kaprow and others, published in 2025 as the open-access digital book The Scores Project.
institutions.desc_zh: 研究机构，其档案收藏 Cage、Brecht、Knowles、Kaprow 等人的乐谱，并于 2025 年以开放获取的数字出版物 The Scores Project 发布。

institutions.name: MASS MoCA
institutions.based_zh: 马萨诸塞州北亚当斯，美国
institutions.desc_en: Hosts Sol LeWitt: A Wall Drawing Retrospective (opened 2008), where teams of drafters re-executed 105 wall drawings from LeWitt's written instructions.
institutions.desc_zh: 长期展出 Sol LeWitt: A Wall Drawing Retrospective（2008 年开幕），由绘图员团队按照勒维特的书面指令重新绘制墙绘。

institutions.name: Yale University Art Gallery
institutions.based_zh: 康涅狄格州纽黑文，美国
institutions.desc_en: Co-organised the MASS MoCA LeWitt retrospective with the Williams College Museum of Art, supplies the instructions and diagrams its drafters follow, and owns Wall Drawing #11.
institutions.desc_zh: 与 Williams College Museum of Art 共同策划 MASS MoCA 的勒维特回顾展，提供绘图员所依据的指令与图示，并收藏 Wall Drawing #11。

institutions.name: Dia Art Foundation
institutions.desc_en: Commissioned Thomas Hirschhorn's Gramsci Monument (2013) with residents of the Bronx and carries on Beuys' 7000 Oaks with trees planted in New York.
institutions.desc_zh: 委托 Thomas Hirschhorn 与布朗克斯居民共同完成 Gramsci Monument（2013），并在纽约种树延续博伊斯的 7000 Oaks。

institutions.name: Walker Art Center
institutions.desc_en: Organised the 1993 touring exhibition and catalogue In the Spirit of Fluxus, a standard reference for Fluxus scores and events.
institutions.desc_zh: 1993 年策划巡回展及同名图录 In the Spirit of Fluxus，是研究激浪派乐谱与事件的常用参考。

institutions.name: Serralves Museum of Contemporary Art
institutions.desc_en: Staged Yoko Ono's Add Colour (Refugee Boat), in which visitors gradually cover a white room and boat with blue marks.
institutions.desc_zh: 展出小野洋子的 Add Colour (Refugee Boat)：观众逐渐用蓝色笔迹覆盖白色房间与船。

institutions.name: Independent Curators International (ICI)
institutions.desc_en: Toured Hans Ulrich Obrist's do it, an exhibition made only of artists' instructions, to at least 50 venues and published do it: the compendium (2013).
institutions.desc_zh: 将 Hans Ulrich Obrist 仅由艺术家指令构成的展览 do it 巡回到至少 50 个地点，并出版 do it: the compendium（2013）。

institutions.name: Primary Information
institutions.desc_en: Non-profit publisher that reissues out-of-print artists' books and writings, a key source for re-reading scores and conceptual instructions.
institutions.desc_zh: 非营利出版社，重印绝版的艺术家书与艺术家文字，是重读乐谱与观念指令的重要来源。

institutions.name: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA)
institutions.desc_en: Owns LeWitt's Wall Drawing #1 and #273 and Learning to Love You More, and showed Harold Cohen's AARON drawing live in 1979.
institutions.desc_zh: 收藏勒维特的 Wall Drawing #1、#273 与 Learning to Love You More，并于 1979 年现场展示 Harold Cohen 的 AARON 作画。

institutions.name: Art Institute of Chicago
institutions.desc_en: Owns Felix Gonzalez-Torres' candy spill "Untitled" (Portrait of Ross in L.A.), which visitors deplete and staff replenish, and LeWitt's Wall Drawing #118.
institutions.desc_zh: 收藏 Felix Gonzalez-Torres 的糖果堆 "Untitled" (Portrait of Ross in L.A.)（观众取走、馆方补充）以及勒维特的 Wall Drawing #118。

institutions.name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
institutions.desc_en: Commissioned Mark Napier's net.flag, acquired Tino Sehgal's This Progress as its first live work, and holds works by Tania Bruguera and Francis Alÿs.
institutions.desc_zh: 委托 Mark Napier 创作 net.flag，将 Tino Sehgal 的 This Progress 作为首件现场作品收藏，并收藏 Tania Bruguera 与 Francis Alÿs 的作品。

institutions.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
institutions.desc_en: Commissions net art through artport, holds an Autoglyph and early participatory web works, and hosted the McCoys' Public Key/Private Key (2019), built on Monegraph.
institutions.desc_zh: 通过 artport 委托网络艺术，收藏 Autoglyph 与早期参与式网络作品，并于 2019 年展出 McCoy 夫妇基于 Monegraph 的 Public Key/Private Key。

institutions.name: Institute of Contemporary Arts (ICA)
institutions.desc_en: Hosted the 1962 Festival of Misfits, where Alison Knowles' Proposition (Make a Salad) was first performed.
institutions.desc_zh: 1962 年举办 Festival of Misfits，Alison Knowles 的 Proposition (Make a Salad) 在此首演。

institutions.name: Whitechapel Gallery
institutions.desc_en: Co-publishes the Documents of Contemporary Art series, including Claire Bishop's anthology Participation (2006), and staged Yoko Ono's Mend Piece for London (2021).
institutions.desc_zh: 与 MIT Press 合作出版 Documents of Contemporary Art 丛书（包括 Claire Bishop 编的 Participation，2006），并展出小野洋子的 Mend Piece for London（2021）。

institutions.name: New Museum
institutions.desc_en: Rhizome's host institution, which premiered the Net Art Anthology exhibition The Art Happens Here (2019) and staged David Horvitz's Let us keep our own noon.
institutions.desc_zh: Rhizome 的依托机构，2019 年首展 Net Art Anthology 展览 The Art Happens Here，并上演 David Horvitz 的 Let us keep our own noon。

institutions.name: documenta
institutions.desc_en: Five-yearly exhibition where Beuys ran his Office for Direct Democracy (1972) and began 7000 Oaks (1982), and Ai Weiwei brought 1,001 Chinese visitors for Fairytale (2007).
institutions.desc_zh: 每五年举办一次的大展：博伊斯在此开设直接民主办公室（1972）、启动 7000 Oaks（1982），艾未未为《童话》带来 1001 位中国访客（2007）。

institutions.name: Tate (Tate Modern)
institutions.desc_en: Staged participatory commissions in Tate Modern's Turbine Hall, such as Sehgal's These Associations and Bruguera's Tatlin's Whisper #5, and collects the archives of works like The Battle of Orgreave and The Crystal Quilt.
institutions.desc_zh: 在泰特现代美术馆涡轮大厅上演 Sehgal 的 These Associations、Bruguera 的 Tatlin's Whisper #5 等参与式委托，并收藏 The Battle of Orgreave、The Crystal Quilt 等作品的档案。

institutions.name: Creative Time
institutions.desc_en: Public-art commissioner that co-produced Tania Bruguera's Immigrant Movement International and Paul Ramírez Jonas' Key to the City.
institutions.desc_zh: 公共艺术委托机构，联合制作 Tania Bruguera 的 Immigrant Movement International 与 Paul Ramírez Jonas 的 Key to the City。

institutions.name: Artangel
institutions.desc_en: Commissioned Jeremy Deller's re-enactment The Battle of Orgreave (2001) and Francis Alÿs' Guards, both staged with hundreds of participants.
institutions.desc_zh: 委托 Jeremy Deller 的重演作品 The Battle of Orgreave（2001）与 Francis Alÿs 的 Guards，两者都由数百名参与者完成。

institutions.name: Queens Museum
institutions.desc_en: Partnered with Creative Time on Tania Bruguera's Immigrant Movement International, a community space in Corona, Queens, from 2011 to 2015.
institutions.desc_zh: 与 Creative Time 合作支持 Tania Bruguera 的 Immigrant Movement International，2011 至 2015 年在皇后区 Corona 运营社区空间。

institutions.name: Van Abbemuseum
institutions.desc_en: Hosted SUPERFLEX's Free Sol LeWitt (2010), a workshop that copied a LeWitt sculpture in the museum and gave the replicas away by lottery.
institutions.desc_zh: 2010 年展出 SUPERFLEX 的 Free Sol LeWitt：在馆内作坊复制勒维特的雕塑，再以抽签方式把复制品送出。

institutions.name: e-flux
institutions.desc_en: Art publishing and announcement platform that launched Time/Bank, where artists and curators trade hours of work instead of money.
institutions.desc_zh: 艺术出版与公告平台，发起 Time/Bank，让艺术家和策展人以工作时数而非金钱进行交换。

institutions.name: Serpentine
institutions.desc_en: Its technology programme co-produced Herndon and Dryhurst's The Call and its data trust, published All Media Is Training Data, and partnered on DAOWO.
institutions.desc_zh: 其艺术与技术项目联合制作 Herndon 与 Dryhurst 的 The Call 及其数据信托，出版 All Media Is Training Data，并参与 DAOWO。

institutions.name: Carnegie Museum of Art
institutions.desc_en: Its 58th Carnegie International (2022) included terra0's A tree; a corporation; a person., a tree set up to hold legal and financial agency.
institutions.desc_zh: 第 58 届 Carnegie International（2022）展出 terra0 为其创作的 A tree; a corporation; a person.，一棵被设定为拥有法律与财务能动性的树。

institutions.name: KW Institute for Contemporary Art
institutions.desc_en: First venue of Herndon and Dryhurst's Starmirror (2025–26), where visitors sang from a songbook to train an AI choir.
institutions.desc_zh: Herndon 与 Dryhurst 的 Starmirror（2025–26）首站：观众按歌本演唱，用录音训练一支 AI 合唱团。

institutions.name: Kunstsammlung Nordrhein-Westfalen (K21)
institutions.desc_en: Showed Starmirror at K21 in 2026 and added scheduled 'Training Performances' to it.
institutions.desc_zh: 2026 年在 K21 展出 Starmirror，并增加了定时举行的“训练演出”。

institutions.name: Berggruen Arts & Culture (Palazzo Diedo)
institutions.desc_en: Presented Herndon and Dryhurst's Attention Guild in the 2026 exhibition Strange Rules at Palazzo Diedo.
institutions.desc_zh: 在 Palazzo Diedo 的 2026 年展览 Strange Rules 中展出 Herndon 与 Dryhurst 的 Attention Guild。

institutions.name: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)
institutions.desc_en: Coordinated a city-wide reinvention of Kaprow's Fluids in 2008, joined Tom Sachs' Rocket Factory launches, and collects CryptoPunks.
institutions.desc_zh: 2008 年在洛杉矶全城重新演绎 Kaprow 的 Fluids，参与 Tom Sachs 的 Rocket Factory 发射，并收藏 CryptoPunks。

institutions.name: Centre Pompidou
institutions.desc_en: Acquired blockchain works in 2023, including two Bitchcoins, CryptoPunks and Autoglyphs.
institutions.desc_zh: 2023 年收藏区块链作品，包括两枚 Bitchcoin、CryptoPunks 与 Autoglyphs。

institutions.name: Vera List Center for Art and Politics
institutions.desc_en: Research centre at The New School whose multi-year focus theme on protocols produced the open-access book As for Protocols (2025).
institutions.desc_zh: The New School 下属研究中心，其以“协议”为主题的多年项目产出了开放获取图书 As for Protocols（2025）。

institutions.name: Furtherfield (and DECAL)
institutions.desc_en: Gallery and lab in Finsbury Park that commissioned Sarah Friend's ClickMine and Rhea Myers' Balloon Dog, and through its DECAL lab ran DAOWO and CultureStake.
institutions.desc_zh: 位于芬斯伯里公园的画廊与实验室，委托了 Sarah Friend 的 ClickMine 和 Rhea Myers 的 Balloon Dog，并通过 DECAL 实验室开展 DAOWO 与 CultureStake。

institutions.name: Rhizome
institutions.desc_en: Born-digital art organisation whose Seven on Seven (2014) produced Monegraph, which co-commissioned Sarah Friend's Off: Endgame, and which runs the ArtBase and Net Art Anthology.
institutions.desc_zh: 专注数字原生艺术的机构：2014 年 Seven on Seven 催生了 Monegraph，联合委托 Sarah Friend 的 Off: Endgame，并运营 ArtBase 与 Net Art Anthology。

institutions.name: ZKM | Center for Art and Media
institutions.desc_en: Media art museum and research centre that, with the Goethe-Institut, commissioned the Media Art Net archive of network and participatory works.
institutions.desc_zh: 媒体艺术博物馆与研究中心，与歌德学院共同委托建立收录网络艺术与参与式作品的 Media Art Net 档案。

institutions.name: Ars Electronica
institutions.desc_en: Festival and centre that hosted Robert Adrian's The World in 24 Hours (1982) and Ken Goldberg's Telegarden in its lobby from 1996.
institutions.desc_zh: 艺术节与中心：1982 年举办 Robert Adrian 的 The World in 24 Hours，1996 年起在大厅运行 Ken Goldberg 的 Telegarden。

institutions.name: S+T+ARTS Prize
institutions.desc_en: European Commission prize for art, science and technology, run by Ars Electronica, that awarded Holly+ in 2022 and features Hashd0x, Botto and The Call.
institutions.desc_zh: 由 Ars Electronica 运营的欧盟艺术、科学与技术奖，2022 年授奖 Holly+，并收录 Hashd0x、Botto 与 The Call。

institutions.name: Eyebeam
institutions.desc_en: Non-profit art and technology centre whose residencies have supported artists building open-source and networked works since the late 1990s.
institutions.desc_zh: 非营利艺术与技术中心，自 1990 年代末起通过驻留项目支持艺术家创作开源与网络作品。

institutions.name: transmediale
institutions.desc_en: Festival for art and digital culture where terra0's self-owning forest proposal circulated in 2017 and Artists Re:Thinking the Blockchain launched in 2018.
institutions.desc_zh: 艺术与数字文化节：terra0 的自有森林提案于 2017 年在此传播，Artists Re:Thinking the Blockchain 于 2018 年在此发布。

institutions.name: V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
institutions.desc_en: Interdisciplinary centre for art and technology that has produced and archived networked and interactive art since the 1980s.
institutions.desc_zh: 跨学科艺术与技术中心，自 1980 年代起制作并存档网络与互动艺术。

institutions.name: LI-MA (Living Media Art)
institutions.desc_en: Platform for the preservation, distribution and research of media art, including software and net-based works.
institutions.desc_zh: 致力于媒体艺术保存、发行与研究的平台，涵盖软件与网络作品。

institutions.name: HEK (Haus der Elektronischen Künste)
institutions.desc_en: Swiss museum for digital art whose 2023 exhibition Exploring the Decentralized Web – Art on the Blockchain showed Rhea Myers' Is Art (Editions).
institutions.desc_zh: 瑞士数字艺术博物馆，2023 年展览 Exploring the Decentralized Web – Art on the Blockchain 展出 Rhea Myers 的 Is Art (Editions)。

institutions.name: Gray Area
institutions.desc_en: Art and technology non-profit whose 2018 exhibition Distributed Systems showed Rhea Myers' SchellingFlags.
institutions.desc_zh: 艺术与技术非营利机构，2018 年展览 Distributed Systems 展出 Rhea Myers 的 SchellingFlags。

institutions.name: NEoN Digital Arts
institutions.desc_en: Scottish digital arts festival that showed Sarah Friend's ClickMine, a clicker game in which every click is a paid Ethereum transaction.
institutions.desc_zh: 苏格兰数字艺术节，展出 Sarah Friend 的 ClickMine：每次点击都是一笔需付费的以太坊交易。

institutions.name: FACT (Foundation for Art and Creative Technology)
institutions.desc_en: Co-published Artists Re:Thinking the Blockchain (2017) with Torque Editions and Furtherfield.
institutions.desc_zh: 与 Torque Editions、Furtherfield 共同出版 Artists Re:Thinking the Blockchain（2017）。

institutions.name: Institute of Network Cultures (MoneyLab)
institutions.desc_en: Research institute whose MoneyLab network studies alternative economies and presented the Black Swan DAO model.
institutions.desc_zh: 研究机构，其 MoneyLab 网络研究另类经济，并展示了 Black Swan DAO 模型。

institutions.name: Kunsthalle Zürich
institutions.desc_en: Its 2022 exhibition DYOR (Do Your Own Research) surveyed art on the blockchain and presented Black Swan among its 'seeders'.
institutions.desc_zh: 2022 年展览 DYOR（Do Your Own Research）梳理区块链上的艺术，并将 Black Swan 列为“播种者”之一展出。

institutions.name: LAS Art Foundation
institutions.desc_en: Berlin non-profit for art, technology and science that launched terra0's Autonomous Forest, a forest managed by a DAO, in 2025.
institutions.desc_zh: 关注艺术、技术与科学的柏林非营利机构，2025 年发起 terra0 的 Autonomous Forest，一片由 DAO 管理的森林。

institutions.name: KADIST
institutions.based: Paris, France and San Francisco, US
institutions.desc_en: Collection that acquired terra0's Conditional Power and accepted the obligations its oracle contract places on the owner.
institutions.desc_zh: 收藏 terra0 的 Conditional Power，并接受其预言机合约对藏家施加的义务。

institutions.name: Art Blocks
institutions.desc_en: On-chain generative art platform; its founder Snowfro co-conceived Friendship Bracelets, which gave every Art Blocks holder bracelets to keep and to gift.
institutions.desc_zh: 链上生成艺术平台；创始人 Snowfro 参与构思 Friendship Bracelets，让每位 Art Blocks 持有者领取手链，一条自留、一条赠人。

institutions.name: Feral File
institutions.desc_en: Curated platform for digital art exhibitions co-founded by Casey Reas, where shows are released as sets of on-chain editions.
institutions.desc_zh: 由 Casey Reas 联合创办的数字艺术策展平台，展览以一组链上版本的形式发布。

institutions.name: Verse
institutions.desc_en: Curated platform for collecting digital art that released Rhea Myers' 10K Drop, locked until Ether reaches ten thousand dollars.
institutions.desc_zh: 策展式数字艺术收藏平台，发布了 Rhea Myers 的 10K Drop，该作品在以太币涨到一万美元前一直锁定。

institutions.name: Nifty Gateway
institutions.desc_en: Marketplace that hosted Pak's open-edition protocols The Fungible (with Sotheby's) and Merge; it closed on 23 April 2026.
institutions.desc_zh: 曾承载 Pak 的开放版本协议作品 The Fungible（与苏富比合作）和 Merge 的交易平台，已于 2026 年 4 月 23 日关闭。

institutions.name: SuperRare
institutions.desc_en: Curated marketplace where Botto's community-selected image is auctioned each week.
institutions.desc_zh: 策展式交易平台，Botto 每周由社群投票选出的图像在此拍卖。

institutions.name: Zora
institutions.desc_en: On-chain protocol and platform whose design drew on the idea of hyperstructures, and where the Holly+ DAO auctioned approved works.
institutions.desc_zh: 链上协议与平台，其设计借鉴“超结构”理念；Holly+ DAO 在此拍卖经批准的作品。

institutions.name: Teia
institutions.desc_en: Community-run DAO that has kept the Hic et Nunc contracts and marketplace running on Tezos since the founder shut the original site in 2021.
institutions.desc_zh: 社群运营的 DAO，自 2021 年创始人关闭原网站以来一直维持 Hic et Nunc 合约与市场在 Tezos 上运行。

institutions.name: Fingerprints DAO
institutions.desc_en: Collector DAO focused on blockchain art that showed terra0's Seed Capital at Art Dubai 2022 and co-commissioned Sarah Friend's Off: Endgame.
institutions.desc_zh: 专注区块链艺术的藏家 DAO，2022 年在 Art Dubai 展出 terra0 的 Seed Capital，并联合委托 Sarah Friend 的 Off: Endgame。

institutions.name: NODE Foundation
institutions.based_zh: 加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托，美国
institutions.desc_en: Digital-art non-profit that acquired the CryptoPunks intellectual property from Yuga Labs in 2025 to preserve the collection.
institutions.desc_zh: 数字艺术非营利机构，2025 年从 Yuga Labs 手中取得 CryptoPunks 的知识产权，以保存这一系列。

institutions.name: Christie's
institutions.based: London, UK and New York, US
institutions.desc_en: Auction house that sold a complete Curio Cards set, including the misprint 17b, for 393 ETH in October 2021 and featured Async Art's programmable works.
institutions.desc_zh: 拍卖行，2021 年 10 月以 393 ETH 拍出含错版 17b 的整套 Curio Cards，并展示过 Async Art 的可编程作品。

institutions.name: Sotheby's
institutions.based: London, UK and New York, US
institutions.desc_en: Ran Pak's The Fungible and the 2021 sale Natively Digital, which included Quantum, Secret Artwork and terra0's Two Degrees.
institutions.desc_zh: 举办 Pak 的 The Fungible 以及 2021 年的 Natively Digital 专场，后者包括 Quantum、Secret Artwork 与 terra0 的 Two Degrees。

institutions.name: Phillips
institutions.based: New York, US and London, UK
institutions.desc_en: Offered Sarah Meyohas' re-issued Bitchcoin tokens in May 2021.
institutions.desc_zh: 2021 年 5 月拍卖 Sarah Meyohas 重新发行的 Bitchcoin 代币。

institutions.name: Galerie Nagel Draxler
institutions.desc_en: Gallery with a Crypto Kiosk programme for blockchain art; Rhea Myers directs enquiries about Is Art (Editions) to it.
institutions.desc_zh: 设有 Crypto Kiosk 区块链艺术项目的画廊；Rhea Myers 将 Is Art (Editions) 的收藏咨询指向这里。

institutions.name: Ethereum Foundation
institutions.desc_en: Commissioned Summer of Protocols (2023–25), the research programme that funded artists and researchers to study protocols.
institutions.desc_zh: 委托 Summer of Protocols（2023–25），资助艺术家与研究者研究协议的项目。

institutions.name: Art Basel
institutions.desc_en: Art fair whose editions hosted participatory protocol works such as Jack Butcher's Self Checkout and Work, Luck, Play and the poet Plantoids.
institutions.desc_zh: 艺术博览会，其各站展出过 Jack Butcher 的 Self Checkout、Work, Luck, Play 以及会写诗的 Plantoid 等参与式协议作品。

websites.name: The Scores Project (Getty)
websites.desc_en: Open-access digital publication that reproduces and annotates midcentury experimental scores by Cage, Brecht, Knowles, Kaprow, Shiomi and others.
websites.desc_zh: 开放获取的数字出版物，复制并注释 Cage、Brecht、Knowles、Kaprow、Shiomi 等人的战后实验乐谱。

websites.name: The Fluxus Performance Workbook (2002)
websites.desc_en: Free PDF, edited by Ken Friedman, Owen Smith and Lauren Sawchyn, that collects the texts of hundreds of Fluxus event scores ready to perform.
websites.desc_zh: 由 Ken Friedman、Owen Smith 与 Lauren Sawchyn 编辑的免费 PDF，收录数百条可直接表演的激浪派事件乐谱原文。

websites.name: Monoskop: Fluxus
websites.desc_en: Long bibliography page on Fluxus with scanned catalogues, anthologies of scores and links to collections such as Silverman, Bonotto and Sohm.
websites.desc_zh: 关于激浪派的长篇书目页面，附扫描的展览图录、乐谱选集，以及 Silverman、Bonotto、Sohm 等收藏的链接。

websites.name: Monoskop
websites.desc_en: Wiki for arts and studies founded by Dušan Barok in 2004, hosting scans of key texts and catalogues such as Burnham's Software and LeWitt's Sentences on Conceptual Art.
websites.desc_zh: Dušan Barok 于 2004 年创办的艺术与研究维基，收录 Burnham 的 Software 图录、勒维特的 Sentences on Conceptual Art 等关键文本扫描。

websites.name: UbuWeb
websites.desc_en: Kenneth Goldsmith's archive of avant-garde film, sound and text, including the Fluxfilm Anthology and Fluxus recordings; it paused in 2024 and resumed in 2025.
websites.desc_zh: Kenneth Goldsmith 创办的前卫影像、声音与文本档案，包括 Fluxfilm Anthology 和激浪派录音；2024 年曾暂停，2025 年恢复更新。

websites.name: Sol LeWitt Wall Drawings Catalogue Raisonné
websites.desc_en: Cahiers d'Art Institute's catalogue of LeWitt's wall drawings, recording each drawing's instructions, certificates and installations.
websites.desc_zh: Cahiers d'Art Institute 编制的勒维特墙绘全集，记录每件墙绘的指令、证书与历次安装。

websites.name: Rhizome ArtBase
websites.desc_en: Rhizome's archive of born-digital artworks since 1999, which preserves participatory web works such as SwarmSketch.
websites.desc_zh: Rhizome 自 1999 年起建立的数字原生艺术档案，保存 SwarmSketch 等参与式网络作品。

websites.name: Net Art Anthology (Rhizome)
websites.desc_en: Rhizome's restored and annotated history of net art in 100 works, including The World in 24 Hours, The Thing and The File Room.
websites.desc_zh: Rhizome 以 100 件作品重建并注释的网络艺术史，包括 The World in 24 Hours、The Thing 与 The File Room。

websites.name: artport (Whitney Museum)
websites.desc_en: The Whitney's portal for net art commissions, hosting works such as xhairymutantx, BumpList and The World's First Collaborative Sentence.
websites.desc_zh: 惠特尼美术馆的网络艺术委托门户，收录 xhairymutantx、BumpList 与 The World's First Collaborative Sentence 等作品。

websites.name: Media Art Net / Medien Kunst Netz
websites.desc_en: Bilingual German-English online survey of media art made for ZKM and the Goethe-Institut, with entries on works such as Push and Pull, The File Room and The Thing.
websites.desc_zh: 为 ZKM 与歌德学院制作的德英双语媒体艺术在线综述，收录 Push and Pull、The File Room、The Thing 等作品条目。

websites.name: Ars Electronica Archive
websites.desc_en: Archive of Ars Electronica festivals, Prix entries and catalogues since 1979, a primary source for telematic and network art.
websites.desc_zh: Ars Electronica 自 1979 年以来的艺术节、Prix 参赛作品与图录档案，是远程通信艺术与网络艺术的一手资料来源。

websites.name: ADA – Archive of Digital Art
websites.desc_en: Research database of digital art run by the University for Continuing Education Krems, documenting artists, works and exhibitions.
websites.desc_zh: 由克雷姆斯继续教育大学运营的数字艺术研究数据库，记录艺术家、作品与展览。

websites.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
websites.desc_en: Web archive used to recover the original pages of defunct protocol works such as Monegraph, SwarmSketch and the Hic et Nunc site.
websites.desc_zh: 网页存档工具，用于找回 Monegraph、SwarmSketch 与 Hic et Nunc 网站等已下线协议作品的原始页面。

websites.name: History of Crypto Art (Martin Lukas Ostachowski)
websites.desc_en: Dated timeline of crypto art from 2013 onward, covering early blockchain works, platforms and communities.
websites.desc_zh: 从 2013 年起按时间排列的加密艺术编年表，涵盖早期区块链作品、平台与社群。

websites.name: Hic et Nunc / Teia timeline (crcdng)
websites.desc_en: Community-written, dated history of Hic et Nunc from its 2021 launch through the shutdown and the founding of Teia.
websites.desc_zh: 社群编写、按日期排列的 Hic et Nunc 历史，从 2021 年上线到关闭，再到 Teia 的成立。

websites.name: Teia docs wiki
websites.desc_en: Teia's documentation of its governance, fees, tokens and contract addresses.
websites.desc_zh: Teia 关于治理、费用、代币与合约地址的文档。

websites.name: symbient.life registry
websites.desc_en: Registry of 'symbients', entities formed by organic beings and synthetic systems acting with autonomy, from Plantoid and terra0 to Botto and Truth Terminal.
websites.desc_zh: “共生体”登记册，收录由有机生命与合成系统共同构成、具有自主性的实体，从 Plantoid、terra0 到 Botto、Truth Terminal。

websites.name: CryptoArt.io
websites.desc_en: Sales database of crypto art across platforms such as Art Blocks, SuperRare, Async Art and Hic et Nunc, ranked by artist and artwork.
websites.desc_zh: 跨平台的加密艺术销售数据库，覆盖 Art Blocks、SuperRare、Async Art、Hic et Nunc 等，按艺术家与作品排序。

websites.name: Summer of Protocols
websites.desc_en: Site of the Ethereum Foundation–funded research programme, publishing its essays, the Protocol Reader and other studies of protocols.
websites.desc_zh: 由以太坊基金会资助的研究项目网站，发布其论文、Protocol Reader 等协议研究成果。

websites.name: World Computer Sculpture Garden
websites.desc_en: Contract-based exhibition on Ethereum curated by 0xfff, with Malte Rauch's essay defining protocol art as art that works with the rules of a computing environment.
websites.desc_zh: 由 0xfff 策划、以合约形式存在于以太坊上的展览，附有 Malte Rauch 把协议艺术定义为“处理计算环境规则的艺术”的文章。

websites.name: Carrier Bag
websites.desc_en: Platform for critique of generative media that published Mat Dryhurst's 2025 lecture Protocol Art.
websites.desc_zh: 生成式媒体批评平台，发布了 Mat Dryhurst 2025 年的讲座 Protocol Art。

websites.name: HOLO
websites.desc_en: Magazine on art, science and technology whose Stream section reports on artists building with smart contracts, such as Sarah Friend.
websites.desc_zh: 关于艺术、科学与技术的杂志，其 Stream 栏目报道 Sarah Friend 等以智能合约创作的艺术家。

websites.name: Right Click Save
websites.desc_en: Online magazine of interviews, essays and histories of digital and NFT art.
websites.desc_zh: 刊登数字艺术与 NFT 艺术访谈、评论与历史的在线杂志。

websites.name: e-flux journal
websites.desc_en: Free online art journal whose essays often address participation, networks, labour and alternative economies in art.
websites.desc_zh: 免费在线艺术期刊，常刊登关于艺术中的参与、网络、劳动与另类经济的文章。

websites.name: Artforum
websites.desc_en: Art magazine that first published Sol LeWitt's Paragraphs on Conceptual Art (1967) and Jack Burnham's Systems Esthetics (1968).
websites.desc_zh: 艺术杂志，首次刊发 Sol LeWitt 的 Paragraphs on Conceptual Art（1967）与 Jack Burnham 的 Systems Esthetics（1968）。

websites.name: Torque Editions
websites.desc_en: Itinerant publisher founded in 2014 by Nathan Jones and Sam Skinner that published Artists Re:Thinking the Blockchain and Radical Friends.
websites.desc_zh: Nathan Jones 与 Sam Skinner 于 2014 年创立的流动出版社，出版了 Artists Re:Thinking the Blockchain 与 Radical Friends。

websites.name: Etherscan
websites.desc_en: Ethereum block explorer for reading the verified source code, transactions and holders of smart-contract artworks.
websites.desc_zh: 以太坊区块浏览器，可查看智能合约作品经验证的源代码、交易记录与持有者。

websites.name: Blockscout
websites.desc_en: Open-source block explorer for Ethereum and many other chains, useful for checking contract names and deployment dates.
websites.desc_zh: 适用于以太坊及多条链的开源区块浏览器，可用于核对合约名称与部署日期。

websites.name: PolygonScan
websites.desc_en: Block explorer for Polygon, where contracts such as Sarah Friend's Lifeforms live.
websites.desc_zh: Polygon 链的区块浏览器，Sarah Friend 的 Lifeforms 等合约部署在该链上。

websites.name: TzKT
websites.desc_en: Tezos block explorer for inspecting the Hic et Nunc and Teia contracts, OBJKT tokens and DAO activity.
websites.desc_zh: Tezos 区块浏览器，可查看 Hic et Nunc 与 Teia 的合约、OBJKT 代币及 DAO 活动。

websites.name: Nouns Center
websites.desc_en: Community knowledge hub for Nouns DAO, explaining the daily auction, the treasury and how to get proposals funded.
websites.desc_zh: Nouns DAO 的社群知识中心，介绍每日拍卖、金库以及如何让提案获得资助。

websites.name: Fluxus Portal (fluxus.org)
websites.desc_en: Long-running gateway site linking Fluxus art history with artists who continue to work in the Fluxus spirit.
websites.desc_zh: 长期运营的门户网站，把激浪派艺术史与仍以激浪派精神创作的艺术家连接起来。
